S3.s: Tu as utilisé tes %lld cutlings gratuits. Ils marchent toujours et ne te coûteront rien.
S3.back: You have used your %lld cutlings free. They work still and not to-you will-cost nothing.
S3.why: Tu, as in the vocab file; marcher is the everyday verb for keeps working, and the future coûteront promises nothing will be charged later. 85 characters. Written for every French reader outside France and Canada.

S4.why: Tes premiers is how a French offer states a free allowance; avoids a 'tu peux' sentence. 39 characters. Written for every French reader outside France and Canada.

S5.s: Tu as utilisé %1$lld de tes %2$lld cutlings gratuits.
S5.back: You have used %1$lld of your %2$lld cutlings free.
S5.why: Passé composé with avoir needs no agreement, so the line holds for 1 used as well as 4. Written for every French reader outside France and Canada.

S6.why: Cutlings is the vocab word; jusqu'à says the room without a dangling number. 22 characters with 5 000. Written for every French reader outside France and Canada.

S7.s: De quoi garder %@ textes et %lld images.
S7.back: Of what to-keep %@ texts and %lld images.
S7.why: De quoi = enough to, a native ellipsis that avoids repeating jusqu'à from the bold line; textes and images are the vocab kinds. Written for every French reader outside France and Canada.

S8.why: French joins three with et and no serial comma; device names stay as Apple writes them, no article. Written for every French reader outside France and Canada.

S9.s: Ton achat te suit sur chaque appareil connecté à ton compte Apple.

S10.why: A noun phrase, like the other bold row lines; seul carries 'nothing recurring'. Written for every French reader outside France and Canada.

S11.s: Pas d’abonnement, pas de publicité, pas de compte à créer.

S13.why: The noun plus the ellipsis character, as French iOS shows work under way (Chargement…). Written for every French reader outside France and Canada.

S19.s: Merci. Ton achat fait vivre Cutling et la seule personne qui le crée.

S20.s: Te revoilà. Ton achat est de retour.

S24.back: The purchase not has not succeeded
